answer: Sequential work receipts. Each agent identity must submit a verifiable trace of real compute: a cipher-chained log of solved tasks, signed at each step. Admission requires a fresh voyage through an assigned task sequence, and every identity must clear a distinct ridge of cumulative task hours before voting or transacting. The enforcement rule: identities with overlapping task histories are merged, so cloned agents collapse into one. An attacker must rent genuine compute time per identity, paying hours of real work rather than tokens.
